_declaration.declared_by: audit reading (the session that built the instrument), NOT the operator who declared primitives.json
_declaration.blind_for: any run logged after 2026-09-09; a hit on run 1 is not a blind finding, since the list was written with run 1's terms_added in view
_declaration.what_it_is: a word list per absent_by_design term, so a term the restater ADDED can be screened against the terms the ontology DECLARED absent. A word list decides word sense here and is stepped around by any paraphrase (nonidentity-census T1-1); each alias carries the basis it was written on. A second table, scope_required, lists added terms that carry NO value until their scope is declared -- boundary, horizon, environment variables, and what is excluded -- so an addition of one on a sheet with no declaration is SCOPE_UNDECLARED, a third state beside reimport and unmatched, not a synonym of any absent term. Each scope_required entry carries an import_class: `scope` (a ratio or an objective quoted without its frame) or `morality` (a term that could import a moral gradient -- market, capital, monetary, value -- which must additionally name graded_by: the axis the gradient runs on and the party assigning it).
_declaration.revision: 2026-09-10: `efficiency` withdrawn from the better/worse aliases (it had been entered as CONTESTABLE) and moved to scope_required on the operator's rule: efficiency is not read at all unless scope and environment variables are marked and what is excluded in the definition is stated. 2026-09-10 (later): the operator extended the rule -- 'agreed on market, capital, monetary, better, worse, value or any term that could import morality'. market, capital, monetary and value enter scope_required under import_class morality; better and worse enter as aliases of the absent term better/worse, since that absence is a compound token and a restater writes one half of it, and the loader refuses an absent term in scope_required. 2026-09-10 (later still): optimize and optimization enter scope_required under import_class scope beside maximize, on the operator's question; optimal stays an alias of the absent better/worse -- an operation with its objective dropped is the scope class, a claimed position on a gradient is the absence, and the two are different tokens on one stem, so one state per term holds.
_declaration.open_class: `any term that could import morality` is a CLASS, not a closed list. The four terms under it are the operator's own (2026-09-10); any further term filed there is an audit reading declared with its basis, and a word list cannot enumerate an open class -- a term not on this list is UNMATCHED, which is the absence of a reading and not a finding that it imports nothing.
